title: Introduction

outline.heading: (unnamed opening — Gzira/Malta autobiographical vignette + problem statement)

subsections.label: Pervasiveness preamble + first-generation framing
subsections.summary: Opens with three-decade horizon of digital games and naming of the first-generation hardware (Atari VCS, Spectrum ZX, Amstrad CPC, Commodore 64) that recast media entertainment. Establishes pervasiveness as the warrant for theoretical attention.

subsections.label: Gzira/Amiga autobiographical vignette
subsections.summary: Author positions himself as part of the first generation of children to enter the cybernetic circuit of digital games. Streets emptied when the Amiga arrived; football migrated to flats. The vignette discharges two analytic functions: it grounds digital games in everyday-life situatedness (the play-site as both shared and machine-mediated) and it pre-figures the volume's later claim that digital games yield a symbiotic, taken-for-granted relation with computational machinery. The Kick-Off citation (Dini 1989) anchors machine-as-rule-enforcer; the felt sense of inhabiting represented landscapes (forests, mountains absent on Malta) seeds the spatial-habitation thread.

subsections.label: Question, claim, and PIM-announcement
subsections.summary: The vignette terminates in the volume's animating question — what makes digital games so involving? — and announces the player involvement model (PIM) as the answer. Establishes that other-media frameworks are not irrelevant but inadequate; digital games require both expansion and rethinking of inherited theories. The PIM is said to range from general motivations and attractions to moment-to-moment gameplay — first appearance of the macro/micro span without those labels.

subsections.label: Presence/immersion quandary + incorporation announcement
subsections.summary: The shortening of subjective distance between player and game environment is the load-bearing experiential phenomenon, and it is presently captured by 'presence' and 'immersion' — terms whose analytical value has diminished or fractured (presence-theorists use the term with divergent or conflicting meanings). The book reframes the phenomenon as a blending of experiential phenomena which in their most intensified and internalized form culminate in incorporation. The metalinguistic concession that incorporation is 'ultimately a metaphor like presence or immersion' is significant: Calleja does not claim ontological discovery, only a more robust working concept.

subsections.label: Ch.1 preview — family-resemblance + games-vs-virtual-environments
subsections.summary: GTA IV + Tetris invoked as poles of heterogeneity; Ch.1 will refuse essentialist definition and instead describe constituent elements within a Wittgensteinian family-resemblance framing (Wittgenstein not named here).

subsections.label: Ch.2 preview — four conceptual challenges
subsections.summary: Ch.2 will treat presence + immersion as used in presence theory and game studies respectively, and will outline four challenges. The four challenges are NOT enumerated in the Intro — pure forward-pointer.

subsections.label: Ch.3 preview — PIM + macro/micro temporal-phase distinction
subsections.summary: Ch.3 introduces the PIM via qualitative research and the macro/micro distinction (macro = off-line involvement with the game; micro = moment-to-moment gameplay). Ch.3 also distinguishes game-involvement from film/literature involvement and divorces involvement from fun and from the magic circle.

subsections.label: Ch.4-9 preview — the six dimensions in tight succession
subsections.summary: All six dimensions named with italicized one-clause glosses: kinesthetic (control and movement), spatial (exploration and learning of the game's spatial domain), shared (co-presence, collaboration, competition with other agents human or AI), narrative (ongoing story + scripted narrative), affective (affect generated during gameplay), ludic (decision making in pursuit of game- and self-assigned goals). Macro + micro applied to each. This is the volume's only place where the six dimensions appear together in definitional form.

subsections.label: Ch.10 preview — incorporation + two participant examples
subsections.summary: Ch.10 argues that incorporation avoids the four challenges, is a more accurate metaphor than presence/immersion, and emerges from combinations of PIM dimensions. Closes with two participant-reported incorporating experiences (forward-pointer to IG-10's qualitative-data anchoring).

subsections.label: Closing — volume contribution + holistic-framework claim
subsections.summary: Book's overall contribution restated: rethinking immersion as multifaceted, introducing incorporation to account for the sense of virtual-environment habitation, and offering PIM as a common holistic framework for further research.

concepts.label: presence/immersion quandary
concepts.note: The diagnostic problem the book exists to dissolve: 'immersion' has lost analytical value through popular overuse; 'presence' is used with divergent and even conflicting meanings by main writers in presence theory. Both terms are treated together as flawed inheritances rather than ranked against each other.

concepts.label: incorporation (announcement)
concepts.note: First appearance of the term in its theoretical sense. Defined here only by what it answers (the quandary) and how it relates to PIM (the most intensified and internalized blend of involvement dimensions). The ontological commitments arrive in IG-10.

concepts.label: incorporation 'ultimately a metaphor'
concepts.note: Metalinguistic self-positioning: Calleja concedes incorporation is metaphorical like its predecessors, claiming only that it avoids 'a number of problematic connotations' and yields a more robust concept. Important for the Manual Section B rubric — incorporation is NOT advanced as a literal ontological claim.

concepts.label: player involvement model (preview)
concepts.note: Announced as the volume's apparatus: ranges from general motivations and attractions to detailed analysis of moment-to-moment involvement. Full elaboration deferred to IG-03.

concepts.label: involvement as umbrella analytic
concepts.note: Calleja uses 'involvement' as the spine term throughout the Intro — not 'immersion' or 'presence'. This is the lexical-strategic prelude to the entire PIM apparatus: involvement is the genus; incorporation is a particular intensified species.

concepts.label: six dimensions of player involvement (preview)
concepts.note: Kinesthetic, spatial, shared, narrative, affective, ludic — named with one-clause glosses in tight succession. The only place in the book where the six appear together in definitional form.

concepts.label: macro / micro temporal-phase distinction (preview)
concepts.note: Macro = off-line involvement (initial attraction, reasons for returning, community participation, off-line planning); micro = moment-to-moment in-session involvement within each dimension. Phenomenological-time vocabulary deliberately absent here; Calleja stays operational.

concepts.label: subjective distance between player and game environment
concepts.note: The experiential variable the book theorizes: its shortening yields the sensation of inhabiting the on-screen space. This is the proto-formulation of what IG-10 will reformulate as bidirectional incorporation.

concepts.label: virtual environment habitation
concepts.note: The phenomenon incorporation is meant to account for — the sense of inhabiting an on-screen space. Habitation is the operative metaphor that survives the demolition of immersion + presence.

concepts.label: cybernetic circuit / symbiotic machine relationship
concepts.note: Gzira-vignette frame: digital games introduced the author's generation to a 'symbiotic relationship with machines' and to 'cybernetic circuits' that became taken-for-granted in adult life. Pre-theoretical anticipation of a perception-action loop framing later operationalized in IG-04 + IG-09.

concepts.label: cybernetic-native authorial standpoint
concepts.note: Calleja positions himself as 'part of the first generation of children to dive with great zeal into the alluring cybernetic circuit that games provide.' This is methodologically loaded: the volume's qualitative research will draw on interviewees positioned analogously.

concepts.label: blending of experiential phenomena
concepts.note: Calleja reframes presence/immersion not as stand-alone phenomena but as blends of multiple experiential phenomena afforded by involving gameplay. This is the conceptual move that makes a multi-dimensional model both necessary and sufficient. Distinct from but adjacent to 'intensification' — blending is structural, intensification is gradient.

concepts.label: intensified + internalized blend (incorporation precondition)
concepts.note: The blend culminates in incorporation only when sufficiently intensified and internalized — two operative criteria (intensity + internalization) that anticipate IG-10's rubric without naming its components.

concepts.label: family-resemblance approach to games (preview)
concepts.note: Forward-points to Ch.1; Wittgenstein not named in the Intro. The GTA-IV/Tetris pairing illustrates the heterogeneity warrant.

concepts.label: four conceptual challenges of presence/immersion (preview)
concepts.note: Pure forward-pointer to IG-02 — the four challenges are NOT named or enumerated in the Intro. (They will be: monolithic-conception, agency-without-multidimensionality, exclusionary-logic, undifferentiated-metaphor-mixing per IG-02 / IG-10 deep findings.)

concepts.label: PIM as common holistic framework for further research
concepts.note: Disciplinary-political claim — the volume offers PIM as infrastructure for the field, not as a competing personal theory. Relevant to the dissertation's adoption posture: the Intro itself invites instrumental use.

positions.stance: Immersion has diminished in analytical value due to popular overuse, and presence is fractured by divergent usage among its main theorists; both terms remain useful as descriptors of the phenomenon (shortening of subjective distance) but require replacement at the level of analytical apparatus.
positions.note: Diagnostic position. Not a refusal of the phenomenon — only of the inherited terms.

positions.stance: The shortening of subjective distance between player and game environment is not a stand-alone experiential phenomenon but a blending of multiple experiential phenomena afforded by involving gameplay; in its most intensified and internalized form, this blend culminates in incorporation.
positions.note: Constructive position. Establishes the multi-dimensional warrant for the PIM and the gradient relationship between involvement and incorporation.

positions.stance: Digital game involvement requires a dedicated theoretical apparatus — perspectives from other media are not irrelevant but require expansion and at times rethinking before they apply.
positions.note: Methodological position. Calibrates the relation to inherited theory: neither full importation nor full refusal.

positions.stance: Incorporation is ultimately a metaphor like presence and immersion, but avoids a number of problematic connotations present in those terms and provides a more robust concept for researchers to build on.
positions.note: Metalinguistic position. Calleja concedes the trope-status of his own term — relevant to anti-realist or constructivist readings, and to dissertation Section E's reckoning with ontological grounding (Calleja's text is hostile to literal-ontological readings of incorporation as written).

positions.stance: The PIM is offered as a common holistic framework for further research in the area, not as a competing private theory.
positions.note: Disciplinary-political position. Licenses the dissertation's instrumental adoption.

tensions.label: metaphor-disclaimer vs. analytic-superiority claim
tensions.summary: Calleja simultaneously concedes that incorporation is 'ultimately a metaphor like presence or immersion' AND claims it provides a 'more robust concept for researchers to build on.' The robustness must therefore live in something other than literal accuracy — i.e., in the metaphor's tracking of the multi-dimensional phenomenon, not in any ontological gain. This tension is consequential for any project that wants to ground incorporation ontologically (e.g., the dissertation's Layer A): the grounding has to come from outside Calleja, since Calleja explicitly denies that incorporation gets us closer to the thing itself.

tensions.label: other-media frameworks: rethinking vs. expansion
tensions.summary: Calleja says digital-game involvement requires 'an expansion and, at times, a rethinking' of theories developed for other media. 'Expansion' and 'rethinking' are not the same operation — expansion preserves the framework's core; rethinking revises it. Calleja does not specify which inherited frameworks get which treatment; the chapter-by-chapter posture varies (e.g., Aarseth's ergodicity is extended; presence-theory's exclusionary logic is repudiated in IG-10). The Intro leaves the gradient unresolved.

tensions.label: involvement universal vs. incorporation gated
tensions.summary: Involvement is offered as the umbrella covering all engagement (general motivations through moment-to-moment gameplay). Incorporation is the intensified + internalized culmination. The Intro does not specify what gates the transition — neither the intensity threshold nor the internalization threshold are specified. IG-10 will install the spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone and the simultaneity condition as gates; the Intro leaves this open, which means the Intro alone cannot decide whether a given experience counts as incorporated. Practical consequence: anyone reading only the Intro could misapply incorporation as a synonym for strong involvement.

game_loci.analytic_role: Exemplar of digital game offering structured competitive play with rule-enforcement by the machine (Gzira vignette). Anticipates the machine-upheld-rules motif developed in IG-01 (Coded Rules) and IG-09 (ludic involvement / agency under rule-constraint).
One pole of the family-resemblance heterogeneity argument, paired with Tetris. Forward-points to IG-01's expanded treatment of GTA IV as a virtual environment with embedded games.

Abstract-puzzle pole of the family-resemblance pairing. Tetris recurs in IG-02 as Salen+Zimmerman's immersive-fallacy exemplar and in IG-10 as excluded from incorporation by the spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone requirement.

game_loci_note: Three games named; all three are passing-illustrative, not analytic. The Commodore Amiga, Atari VCS, Spectrum ZX, Amstrad CPC, Commodore 64 are named as platforms (book p.1) but no specific games are attached to those platforms in the Intro.
interlocutors_note: ZERO theorists cited by name in the Introduction. Confirmed across book pp.1-5. No Murray, Ryan, Aarseth, Juul, Salen+Zimmerman, McMahan, Wittgenstein, presence-theory names, or any other interlocutor surfaces in the Intro. All interlocutor engagement is deferred to IG-01 (Wittgenstein, Naess, Suits, Salen+Zimmerman, Juul, Aarseth, Taylor, Malaby) and IG-02 onward. This is consistent with the volume's rhetorical strategy: the Intro performs the argument programmatically, then names interlocutors only when engaging them substantively.

candidate_augmentation_mappings.provenance_note: Per Phase 0 cite_check: Burke, Aristotle, Uexkull, Merleau-Ponty, Gibson, Csikszentmihalyi, Biocca, Tronstad ALL ABSENT from Calleja's text; Heidegger present only at p.21 (single Question Concerning Technology cite). Hence ALL augmentation mappings below are anticipatory only.

layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.ontological_target: Heideggerian Entfernung (de-distancing / dis-tancing) from Being and Time §23
layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.rationale: Calleja's 'shortening of subjective distance between player and game environment' is conceptually adjacent to Heidegger's account of Dasein's tendency toward bringing-close (Ent-fernung). Anticipatory only — Calleja's text contains no phenomenological vocabulary at this point.

layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.ontological_target: Aristotelian topos / Heideggerian In-der-Welt-sein (with the caveat from plan v3 §5 that Uexküll's Umwelt may be more apt for designer-constituted environments)
layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.rationale: 'Habitation' is the operative metaphor that survives the demolition of presence/immersion. Its ontological grounding is left wholly open by Calleja.

layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.ontological_target: BCAP phenomenology of time + Bowin AMT time-perception
layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.rationale: Macro/micro is operational-temporal; phenomenological grounding awaits dissertation. This is the strongest pre-augmentation candidate per Phase 0 manifest.

layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.ontological_target: Aristotelian energeia / entelecheia (incorporation as the actualization of dimensional potentials)
layer_a_aristotle_heidegger.rationale: Speculative — Calleja explicitly disclaims ontological commitment ('ultimately a metaphor'), so any energeia-grounding move is dissertation-projection against the grain of Calleja's metalinguistic stance.

layer_b_burke_pentad.pentad_mapping: Kinesthetic→Agency; Spatial→Scene; Shared→Agent (+ratios); Narrative→Act+Purpose; Affective→Attitude; Ludic→Purpose+Act
layer_b_burke_pentad.rationale: Standard plan v3 pentad mapping applied to the dimension-preview moment. ALL anticipatory — Burke is wholly absent from Calleja.

layer_b_burke_pentad.pentad_mapping: candidate complement: Burke's consubstantiation / identification (Rhetoric of Motives 1950)
layer_b_burke_pentad.rationale: Calleja's 'most intensified and internalized blend' language is structurally adjacent to Burke's identification — both name a relational thickening between agent and scene/audience. Anticipatory.

layer_b_burke_pentad.pentad_mapping: Agency/Scene ratio (the machine as both means and milieu)
layer_b_burke_pentad.rationale: Anticipatory — the Gzira vignette's cybernetic-circuit framing invites a Burkean Agency/Scene ratio reading.

layer_c_uexkull.rationale: Layer C's signature payoff per plan v3 §5 — Umwelt is arguably more apt than Heideggerian In-der-Welt-sein for the bounded, designer-constituted nature of virtual environments. Singly-anchored (Gibson-mediation falsified per Phase 0).

layer_c_uexkull.uexkull_construct: Funktionskreis (functional circle: perception-marker → effect-marker → object → perception-marker)
layer_c_uexkull.rationale: Calleja's 'cybernetic circuit' framing in the Gzira vignette is structurally analogous to the Uexküllian perception-action loop — both name a closed feedback between organism (player) and environment (game). Anticipatory only; Calleja never names Uexküll or invokes biosemiotic vocabulary.
The shortening of subjective distance can be reframed as a tightening coupling of Merkwelt and Wirkwelt — perception and effective action collapsed into a single felt loop. Highly speculative.

candidate_augmentation_mappings.gibson_pipeline_status: pending-future-pipeline. Per Phase 0 cite_check.gibson: Calleja uses 'affordance' 11 times generically without Gibson attribution and Gibson does not appear in references or index. The Gibson-as-implicit-Uexküll-bridge hypothesis is FALSIFIED. Layer C remains singly-anchored anticipatory at the Intro level.

residual_phenomenology_flags.passage: Subjective distance + sensation of inhabiting the space represented on-screen (book p.2, fulltext lines 63-66)
residual_phenomenology_flags.phenomenological_residue: The language of 'subjective distance,' 'sensation of inhabiting,' and 'shortening' is residually phenomenological — it invokes lived-experience vocabulary (distance-as-felt, inhabiting-as-mode-of-being) without naming any phenomenologist. Heidegger's Entfernung is the closest fit; Merleau-Ponty on inhabited space is another. Calleja cites neither.
residual_phenomenology_flags.note: Strong candidate for Manual Section E Layer A anchoring. Calleja's lexicon does the phenomenological work without crediting the phenomenological tradition.

residual_phenomenology_flags.passage: Cybernetic circuit + symbiotic relationship with machines (book pp.1-2, fulltext lines 40-46)
residual_phenomenology_flags.phenomenological_residue: 'Symbiotic relationship' and 'cybernetic circuit' are quasi-phenomenological framings of human-machine coupling. The closest disciplinary anchors are Dovey+Kennedy (cybernetic-circuit, named in IG-03), Uexküll's Funktionskreis (Calleja never cites), and Merleau-Ponty on technical incorporation (Calleja never cites).
residual_phenomenology_flags.note: Layer A + Layer C both candidate-anchors here. The Funktionskreis mapping in candidate_augmentation_mappings.layer_c_uexkull is the natural Layer C target; Merleau-Ponty's chapter on the blind man's cane is the natural Layer A target if the dissertation activates Merleau-Ponty.

residual_phenomenology_flags.passage: Blending of experiential phenomena + intensified and internalized blend (book p.3, fulltext lines 79-82)
residual_phenomenology_flags.phenomenological_residue: 'Experiential phenomena' and 'internalized' are phenomenological terms of art, used by Calleja without phenomenological citation. 'Internalization' especially has a developed phenomenological lineage (Husserl on Vergegenwärtigung; Heidegger on appropriation; later embodied-cognition uses).
residual_phenomenology_flags.note: Anchor candidate but lower-yield — the term 'internalized' may be doing more colloquial than technical work in Calleja's prose.

residual_phenomenology_flags.passage: Habitation as the surviving metaphor (book p.5, fulltext lines 153-156)
residual_phenomenology_flags.phenomenological_residue: Habitation/inhabiting is the volume's surviving spatial-phenomenological metaphor after the demolition of presence/immersion. Heidegger's Bauen Wohnen Denken (1951) is the most direct anchor; Bachelard's Poetics of Space another. Calleja cites neither.
residual_phenomenology_flags.note: Highest-yield Layer A anchor candidate in the Intro. The dissertation's Heideggerian wing should expect to do significant work here — habitation is the term Calleja never philosophically grounds but the term his entire constructive project relies on.

incorporation_stance_consistency_with_ig.ig_10_finding: Per IG-10 deep edges + propagated finding: Murray (1998 Hamlet on the Holodeck) is ABSORBED-not-refused — incorporation IS Calleja's term for immersion-as-transportation, expanded by double-axis structure (book p.172).
incorporation_stance_consistency_with_ig.intro_consistency: The Intro is consistent with the IG-10 stance and in fact previews it implicitly. Calleja says incorporation 'avoids a number of problematic connotations that are present in [presence and immersion] and, more importantly, provides a more robust concept' — note 'avoids problematic connotations,' not 'replaces the phenomenon.' The Intro thus anticipates the IG-10 absorptive-not-refusive posture: the phenomenon-cluster captured by Murray/Ryan/Brown+Cairns/etc. is preserved; only the terms and their connotations are replaced. This is the Intro's first quiet move toward IG-10's bidirectional + cornerstone-gated incorporation.
incorporation_stance_consistency_with_ig.flag: ANTICIPATORY-CONSISTENT — no contradiction. The Intro does not pre-commit to the spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone, the simultaneity condition, or the bidirectional-axis structure (all IG-10 deliverables), but it leaves space for all of them.

cross_pipeline_bridges_summary: Dalton dissertation: PIM + incorporation announced as the volume's apparatus → dissertation-instrument provenance (highest-priority bridge per plan v3 §5).
Phantasia Cluster: 'transported our imaginations,' 'sensation of inhabiting' → spatial-imagistic phantasma operations (anticipatory).
Heidegger BCAP: macro/micro temporal-phase preview → BCAP phenomenology of time (anticipatory, strongest pre-augmentation candidate).
Uncomfortable Situations (Gross 2017): affective involvement preview → IG-08 is the primary bridge; Intro contributes only the dimension-name placeholder.
Uexküll Foray: cybernetic-circuit + habitation → Funktionskreis + Umwelt (anticipatory, singly-anchored; Gibson-mediation falsified).
content_filter_compliance: Compliant. Paraphrastic narrative only; no ≥25-word verbatim from Calleja in either ig-00-deep.md or this JSON. Italicized one-word concept-names (kinesthetic, spatial, etc.) are technical terms and do not count toward verbatim threshold per corpus convention.
notes: Intro is consistent with both IG-03 and IG-10 prior findings. The Murray-absorbed-not-refused stance (IG-10 propagated finding) is anticipated in the Intro's 'avoids problematic connotations' framing without being explicitly claimed. Four residual-phenomenology flags surfaced (RP1 subjective-distance, RP2 cybernetic-circuit, RP3 internalization, RP4 habitation) — all candidates for Manual Section E Layer A anchoring. The Intro's metaphor-disclaimer (IG-00.T1) is a genuine constraint on any future ontological-grounding move: Calleja explicitly disclaims that incorporation gets closer to the thing itself, so Layer A grounding must be argued against the grain of Calleja's metalinguistic stance, not as exegetical recovery of something latent.
